arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Yun Jin from Genshin Impact expressing confusion, using only the supplied approved neutral as the image reference. Preserve the neutral's exact identity, petite Medium Female build, face, skin tone, indigo hair and fringe, reddish-pink eyes, opera headdress, tassels, white collar, pink shoulder panels, patterned purple dress, pale front panel, tights and decorated boots. Match its detailed anime illustration style and compact proportions.
Acting: give her an unmistakably puzzled but graceful look: right brow lifted, left brow drawn slightly inward, eyes glancing sideways, lips gently parted as if asking a quiet question. Tilt her head toward her right shoulder and shift her weight onto one leg. Her right elbow bends loosely with the right hand hovering at lower-abdomen height, palm angled inward and fingers relaxed together; leave a little space between the hand and dress. Her left arm lowers beside her hip with a softly relaxed hand clear of the skirt. Use her head tilt, shoulders and facial expression to communicate uncertainty. Keep a poised opera performer's bearing and a pose distinct from neutral.
Hands should look naturally drawn and softly articulated: each palm connects to four fingers and its separate opposable thumb, with gentle joints and clear silhouettes suited to the pose. Let natural overlap remain natural; do not force every digit toward the viewer. Keep the hands separate from each other and clear of clothing, without touching the collar or face. Keep the feet uncrossed and costume motifs following the body naturally.
Show the complete silhouette including headdress, hair, sleeves, hands and shoes with roughly 2–4% padding. Use a genuinely transparent background. No props, scenery, floor, ground shadow, effects, text, labels, UI or watermark. Ordinary pupils, no heart pupils. Preserve the approved outfit and build throughout.

approval.message: Zibai accepted, Yun Jin accepted. Mizuki: Confusion - distorted hands, Desire - distorted eyes, Embarrassment - distorted eyes, Excitement - distorted eyes. I think the issue with Mizuki’s eyes might be part of her neutral. Try regenerating the Mizuki neutral, and then use her in game model as a secondary reference for each emotion thereafter.
